### Relationships:

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **"Pond Lead" vs "Team Members" distinction:** The Pond Lead column shows a single avatar — this is the designated manager/owner of the pond (likely receives admin notifications, can view all leads in the pond). Team Members are the agents who actually receive and work the leads. The Pond Lead may or may not be in the Team Members rotation [INFERRED — verify with FUB docs].

2. **Avatar stack rendering:** The Team Members column renders avatars in an overlapping stack (right-offset). Each avatar needs a z-index that increases left-to-right, or the stack needs to reverse the order so the leftmost avatar is on top visually. Standard pattern: `margin-left: -8px` on each avatar after the first, with `z-index` descending.

3. **"Pond Lead" column header is two lines stacked:** The column header renders "Pond" on the first line and "Lead" on the second. This is unusual — it's likely because the column is very narrow (just wide enough for one avatar) and the two-word label wraps. Implement with `white-space: normal` and a narrow column width.

4. **Multi-line column header:** Only the "Pond Lead" column has this two-line layout. All other column headers appear single-line.

5. **Table is minimal / low-density for an admin list:** There is no search bar, no filter bar, no sort controls, and no pagination visible. The assumption is that ponds are infrequent entities (most accounts have just a handful) so no filtering is needed.

6. **Empty state (not currently shown):** If no ponds existed, there would likely be an empty-state component in the table body — text like "No ponds yet" with a call-to-action button to create the first pond [INFERRED].

7. **The URL pattern `/2/ponds` uses an account-scoped numeric ID:** The `/2/` segment is the FUB account ID. All admin routes follow `/{account_id}/{section}` pattern.

8. **Edit vs. pond name link:** Both the pond name link and the edit pencil icon likely lead to the same destination (pond edit/detail page). The trash icon is a separate destructive action.

9. **"How Ponds work" link placement:** This help link is right-aligned within the sub-nav bar, not in the page content area. It sits at the same height as the tab items but floated to the far right, separated visually from the tab list. Implement as a `position: absolute; right: 0` or `margin-left: auto` flex item within the sub-nav flex container.

10. **No "Getting Started" progress bar** appears in this screenshot. Some FUB screens show a green progress bar at the very bottom for onboarding. This account is fully set up, so the bar is either dismissed or absent on admin pages.
